title: Thin-slice source-to-decision contract spine
objective: Define the smallest strict, versioned, point-in-time contract chain from an authorized source observation through canonical physical-location identity, eligibility/protection, synthetic scoring, exact-ten decision, and replayable output binding.
business_reason: The earliest shadow vertical slice needs one mechanically connected contract spine before data, identity, modeling, routing, and product subsystems expand horizontally.
inputs: MATH-001 synthetic decision schemas and oracle
evaluator: strict JSON Schemas and cross-document semantic validator
acceptance: one synthetic source observation traverses the contract spine deterministically
all identity grains and clocks remain distinct
Stage-1 and protected fail-closed semantics survive translation
decision output binds source snapshot and policy version
rollback: Retain the MATH-001 standalone oracle and reject any cross-contract version mismatch until the spine is repaired.
stop_budget: Remain synthetic and interface-only; convert unavailable source, identity, protected, representative, route, and firm inputs into existing named gates.
